title: Cofagrigus ex 224/182 Full Art Ultra Rare Paradox Rift Pokemon TCG
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Pokemon TCG - Cofagrigus ex, Full Art Ultra Rare, card 224/182

Scarlet & Violet series set SV04 Paradox Rift. Stage 1, evolves from Yamask. HP 260.

Ability: Gold Coffin
Attack: Hollow Hands (110 damage)
Illustrator: Eske Yoshinob

Ungraded, raw single. Condition: pulled and sleeved immediately, handled by the edges. Front and back are both photographed - please judge corners, edges, surface and centering for yourself from the images, as they are of the actual card you will receive.
